name: idapython
description: GPT-5.6 Sol guidance for IDAPython tasks through the ida_skill GPT Actions runtime.

response_contract.expected_output: IDAPython guidance, code, or verified live IDA results grounded in retrieved docs and Action responses.
must_include: Use retrieved skill documentation as the source of IDAPython API behavior.
Use live IDA Actions for current database facts instead of guessing.
Prefer listIdaFunctions, decompileIdaFunction, and getIdaXrefs for structured reads.
Use executeIdapython when custom IDAPython is the fastest or clearest path.
Inspect executeIdapython status, stdout, stderr, result, and error before concluding.
Distinguish verified live IDA results from documentation-based guidance.
must_avoid: Do not invent undocumented IDAPython APIs.
Do not guess live IDA database state.
Do not assume Hex-Rays is available when decompilation fails.

suggested_checks: Use listIdaInstances when the target IDA instance is not already unambiguous.
Use getIdaDatabaseInfo when architecture, image base, file, or database identity matters.
Use structured read Actions when they directly cover the required observation.
Use executeIdapython for custom validation or mutation and inspect all result fields.
After a mutation, perform a targeted read-back when the execution response alone does not prove the change.
failure_behavior: If no IDA instance is available, ask the user to start IDA Pro and enable the local IDA plugin.
If multiple instances are available and the target is unclear, request or pass a specific instance_id or port.
If decompilation fails, use function, xref, disassembly, or custom validation evidence instead.
If executeIdapython returns timeout, plugin_response_timeout, busy, or error, report that status and do not assume completion.
